notes.title: You’ve got to try these Golf Gang workshop courses!
notes.content:
Hey there, Golfers! 

Golf Gang has been in your hands for a couple months now, and in that time, we’ve seen some incredible creations come through the workshop. 

Nice work, everyone! 

Today, we want to feature some of our favourite workshop creations, to show some love and to put them on your radar if you haven’t already checked them out. So let’s start from the top! 

[h3][b]Fall Gang[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/578c34a8d2c30843d7f0270353fb810d348a1268.png[/img]

This Fall Guys inspired course is just as vibrant and colourful as the real thing! It’s just as fun too, but with a mini-golf twist. 

Creator: Majesté 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2833502554  

[h3][b]Kart Racing Pack [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/e470f110d4b796f6b4ed7a720ed62944dee8a8a6.png[/img]

Are you a fan of synthwave? Neon? Colourful city scapes? Well the Kart Racing Pack has you covered. Experience real speed in this awesome race to the finish. 

Creator: Capybarrett 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2814307399 

[h3][b]Super Golf Bros. Melee[/b] [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/976e0ccf99c9d4cce8a379978f2fd664e146f3c0.jpg[/img]

Who doesn’t love Super Smash Bros.? This course is a love letter to one of the best ensemble fighting games of all time! 

Creator: Bap Slambino 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821279396 

[h3][b]Space is the Place[/b] [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/83a236dd3853d3479783354d7a48401f6d7a643d.jpg[/img]

Space is definitely the place in Golf Gang. Shoot across the stars in this atmospheric course containing a couple creepy surprises. Hint: don’t veer off the beaten path... just trust us. 

Creator: Splashh 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2815931388

[h3][b]Accent[/b] [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/c82eca986a739281d3f8f70af491221cd111782a.jpg[/img]

The jump and energize modifiers are your best friends on this one. Ascend to the finish line, if you can find it... 

Creator: Null 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2811664042

 
You can see the full list of workshop courses [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1151050/workshop/]here[/url]. There are plenty to check out and play on with your friends! 

If you want to learn how to make your own courses using the Golf Gang workshop, [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLmTpKUr_ehtwcj-yBgCNRlSB_wyooDhMh]check out these workshop tutorial videos[/url]!

notes.title: Golf Gang’s Week 1 Hotfixes
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has purchased and played Golf Gang this week! It’s been great to see you enjoying your time with it. 

We’ve been listening to your feedback and working to address the bugs in Golf Gang. A series of hotfixes have been released since launch, so allow us to outline the changes/improvements for you here: 

[b]Hotfix #1 (23/05/22) [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the paddles/rotating environment objects clipping through the ball when it is still/very slow 
[*] Widened search parameters in lobby browser to allow more lobbies to be visible 
[*] Fixed the Speed Demon (Get gold on every hole of <course name> in time trials mode) achievements not being awarded 
[*] Minor UI updates
[/list] 
[b]Hotfix #2 (25/05/22)[/b] 
[list]
[*] Fixed the propellers moving out of position on Hole 13 of Alpine Resort  
[*] Fixed a bug where .sav file becomes corrupt, preventing players from entering gameplay 
[/list]
There are more hotfixes planned for early next week and onward, so we’ll keep you in the loop along the way. [url=https://t.co/N8z3eGEKFB]Please keep flagging bugs and feedback for us[/url], it’s been extremely helpful so far. 

Also, just a heads up—[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26444/Multiplayer_Party_Bundle/]you can now grab the multiplayer party bundle including Golf Gang and Human: Fall Flat for 44% off on Steam[/url]. Two great party games for a fraction of the price! 

Have a great weekend!
